definitions.explanation: Someone who has reached a high level of proficiency in a skill, sport, language, or other area.

examples.japanese: {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I joined the class for advanced students.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}⟦でないと→でないと：30684_denaito⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: This mountain is dangerous unless you're an experienced climber.

examples.japanese: {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{苦戦|くせん}→苦戦：13990_kusen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧だった。
examples.english: It was such a difficult course that even advanced practitioners struggled.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{上級|じょうきゅう}→上級：11298_joukyuu⟧ (advanced level) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person).

LEVEL SERIES:
Part of a standard three-level proficiency series:
- ⟦{初級者|しょきゅうしゃ}→初級者：29204_shokyuusha⟧: beginner
- ⟦{中級者|ちゅうきゅうしゃ}→中級者：19105_chuukyuusha⟧: intermediate
- {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}: advanced

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}{向|む}け: aimed at advanced learners/users
- {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧: advanced-level course
- {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧: difficult even for advanced people

USAGE:
Used for language learning, sports, skiing/snowboarding, martial arts, games, and any skill-based activity with graded levels.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: skilled person (more casual)
- ⟦{熟練者|じゅくれんしゃ}→熟練者：23783_jukurensha⟧: expert, skilled practitioner (more formal)
- ⟦{達人|たつじん}→達人：14378_tatsujin⟧: master, expert (stronger)
